title: Campus Tours and Visits (USC Admission)
text:
TOUR TYPES
- Student-led tours: current undergraduates lead guests through campus. Offered Monday through Friday. Tours last 75 to 90 minutes. Tours may change or be canceled, with email updates.
- Self-guided tours: available daily during campus entrance hours. Visitors do not need to check in with the Admission Center. A printable version is on the Admission site.
- Academic department sessions: range from facilities tours to sit-down information sessions about one of USC's 23 schools and divisions. For individual student and/or family groups.
- School and community-based organization (CBO) group tours: a teacher, counselor, or administrator must submit the request. High school, community college, and CBO groups with 9th to 12th grade or older students book through the Group Tours calendar (applyto.usc.edu/portal/grouptours). K-8 groups book through the Tommy's Tours calendar (applyto.usc.edu/portal/tommystours).

REGISTRATION
- Formal tours require advance registration. Student-led tours and academic department sessions are booked through applyto.usc.edu/portal/tours.

COST AND PARKING
- Formal tours are free.
- A parking permit costs $20 and must be active during the visit. The Admission Center does not validate parking.

HOURS AND ACCESS RULES
- Student-led tours run Monday through Friday. Self-guided tours follow campus entrance hours.
- Guests who arrive too late for a tour's departure receive a self-guided tour brochure.
- Guests 12 and younger must be accompanied by an adult. Guests 13 to 17 touring without an adult need parent or legal guardian consent included in their reservation.
- Tours do not enter residence halls. Virtual residence hall tours are on the USC Admission YouTube channel.

TALKING TO STUDENTS
- Tour guides cannot be matched to specific majors. Guides can speak generally about USC's more than 150 undergraduate majors.
- Graduate students should contact the academic department of interest.

OTHER NOTES
- USC does not track demonstrated interest, so signing up for a tour or session does not affect admission chances.

CONTACTS
- Accessibility accommodations (mobility or auditory, under the ADA): visitusc@usc.edu or (213) 740-6605, at least five business days before the tour.
- Main Undergraduate Admission line: 213-740-2311.
